findings.title: onReceive lacks whenNotPaused (pause does not halt inbound delivery); onRevert has it
findings.decision_reason: Clear, source-proven modifier asymmetry: onReceive lacks whenNotPaused while onRevert has it. Pause cannot stop inbound delivery. Valid availability/incident-response weakness; source-proven, Medium.

findings.title: Swap deadline computed as block.timestamp+MAX_DEADLINE(200s); Trident path has no deadline (weak MEV protection)
findings.decision_reason: Source-proven weak slippage/deadline: deadline=block.timestamp+200 is always met at inclusion (no staleness protection); Trident path has no deadline. Systematic MEV/sandwich exposure on protocol swaps. Valid Medium.

findings.title: ERC20Custody.withdraw transfers exact amount, ignoring fee-on-transfer tokens (custody insolvency)
findings.decision_reason: Real code asymmetry (withdraw uses raw amount, deposit uses balance-delta). Realized impact conditional on a fee-on-transfer token being whitelisted by TSS; needs an executed PoC to demonstrate custody insolvency. ICE advances to PoC, not direct submit.

findings.title: No internalSendHash replay/dedup tracking in connectors (double-delivery if TSS replays)
findings.decision_reason: No internalSendHash dedup; double-delivery requires TSS to replay (privileged precondition) so not permissionless High, but a defense-in-depth gap worth a PoC of double-mint under replay.

findings.title: Uninitialized interactorsByChainId[chain] (empty bytes) lets empty zetaTxSenderAddress pass sender check
findings.decision_reason: Empty-bytes interactor bypass is a real modifier gap but requires an unregistered chain entry AND a TSS-relayed message; conditional. Needs PoC against a concrete inheriting onZetaMessage to show impact.

findings.title: getEthFromZeta lacks nonReentrant while sending ETH to caller-controlled destinationAddress (cross-fn reentrancy)
findings.decision_reason: Strongest PERMISSIONLESS High-ceiling: getEthFromZeta sends ETH to caller-controlled address with no nonReentrant (getTokenFromZeta has it). Realized fund impact is UNCLEAR statically -> requires an executed L3 harness with a control case before any High can be claimed.

findings.title: Trident strategy uses poolFactory.getPools(...)[0] with no length/zero/legitimacy validation
findings.decision_reason: Unvalidated poolFactory.getPools(...)[0]; fund-loss requires the Trident factory to be permissionless enough to pre-register an attacker pool, or empty -> DoS. Conditional; needs PoC to establish which.
